title: 왜냐하면
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The Korean Basic Dictionary defines **왜냐하면** as “왜 그러냐 하면” (“for the reason that”), introducing an explanation. The entry is limited to this explanatory function and does not prescribe a single sentence-final style.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

National Institute of Korean Language. (s. f.). 왜냐하면. In *Korean Basic Dictionary*. National Institute of Korean Language. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicMarinerSearch/search?mainSearchWord=because&nation=eng

Korean Basic Dictionary, search entry 왜냐하면, definition and examples (search query: because).

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **때문에**, **덕분에** y **-아/어서**, que también expresan relaciones causales. Se distingue de **그래서**, que introduce principalmente el resultado o consecuencia.
